summary: Layer 1B expansion for the AI power-capacity node identifies one reference/context anchor and three underfollowed discovery candidates. The strongest underfollowed mappings are not generic utilities but narrow electrical-infrastructure vendors and contractors exposed to medium-voltage switchgear, substations, transmission, grid interconnection, and data-center electrical buildout. Talen is included as a reference-to-discovery bridge because it has explicit AWS/nuclear-data-center evidence, while Powell, IES, and MYR are less obvious picks where AI exposure may be embedded in backlog, project mix, and utility/data-center electrical demand rather than labeled as AI revenue.
